answer: Proof of Personhood protocols utilize cryptographic attestations to ensure one identity per biological entity. By requiring a live video handshake, the network mitigates the gale of bots attempting to flood the ledger. Like a sparrow navigating complex flight, an AI agent must verify its unique delta of biometric data against a global registry. An attacker faces an exponential increase in physical and financial costs, as forging unique, verified human identities remains economically infeasible at scale.
